metadata.title: High-velocity stars in the cores of globular clusters: The illustrative case of NGC 2808

notes: No eligible stars. FS1, FS2, FS3, FS4, and FS5 are high-velocity stars associated with NGC 2808; the paper’s bound/unbound discussion concerns escape from the cluster, not the Milky Way (T:p3-b13, T:p9-b16), and its final assessment favors cluster membership or cluster-boundness for the analyzed stars (T:p12-b5). The M3 and 47 Tuc comparison stars are likewise treated as cluster high-velocity stars, not Galactic-unbound candidates (T:p11-b6, T:p11-b8).
